scope: Focused Windows actual Chromium/compiled Architect shell, fake authority/executors, no inference; these composed checks are not complete normative UX/GE acceptance

checks.name: B25-01
checks.detail: Actual 1,000 variable-height rows restore selected plan by ID and center only the rail.

checks.name: B25-02
checks.detail: Filtering preserves active plan; explicit reveal adds one labelled row without clearing filters or substituting first plan.

checks.name: B25-03
checks.detail: Background list/detail refresh retains rail scroll instead of stealing focus.

checks.name: B25-04
checks.detail: Menu retains captured plan after selection changes; Ask creates an editable draft without sending or mutating.

checks.name: B25-06
checks.detail: Shift-F10, Home/End, type-ahead and Escape work with focus restoration.

checks.name: B25-07
checks.detail: Captured CAS command rejects changed revision; it cannot silently target the newly selected plan.

checks.name: B25-08
checks.detail: Out-of-order detail loads and delayed reveal ignore stale selection.

checks.name: B25-09
checks.detail: Explicit disclosure chevron and per-plan open state survive lifecycle refresh.

checks.name: B25-10
checks.detail: Narrow/reduced-motion menu stays inside viewport, with touch-visible overflow styling.

checks.name: B25-11
checks.detail: Offline refresh retains the as-of view and exposes failure; reconnect rereads canonical state.

checks.name: B25-12
checks.detail: Sibling overflow controls and slice/concern menus retain native card interactions without nested buttons.

checks.name: B25-13
checks.detail: Actual delayed preference persistence keeps chat bound to its original plan; result cannot refresh the new selection, and mismatched continuation dispatch is stopped.

checks.name: B25-14
checks.detail: Actual approval preview race stops before any lifecycle mutation; the newly selected plan cannot inherit another plan’s reviewed scope.
